sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Fourth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE
(FOURTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance,
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 19th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated 19-10-2002.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Representation of the
People (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Fourth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 12, Act LXXXV of 1976

REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE
(FOURTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE LXXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance,
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-I, 19th October, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated 19-10-2002.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:--
2. Amendment of section 12,
Act LXXXV of 1976.---In the Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV
of 1976), in section 12, for sub-section (3) the following shall be
substituted, namely:-
"(3) Every
nomination paper shall be delivered to the Returning Officer by the candidate
in person and the Returning Officer shall acknowledge receipt of the nomination
paper specifying the date and time of receipt."
